R2: skb3 (new block sr-killed-reset) builds the throwaway normally through a passthrough smudge filter, then deletes hang.txt in the throwaway and arms a marker; the one reset made while armed gets its own short timeout and disarms on return, so exactly one reset hangs: asserts events == ['kill','drain','remove'], could-not-prove, removed from disk and from git's list. Probe first (scratchpad probe_smudge.py): `checkout -f HEAD -- .` does not re-smudge an unchanged file, re-smudges a deleted one - hence the deletion. skb4 records _isolate's git calls: [('checkout', True), ('clean', True)]. srn1-srn3 (new block sr-run-confirm) drive _run_in with tear_down swapped to confirm without killing and drain_to_eof swapped: no EOF with the root gone -> '(not confirmed)'; EOF with the root alive -> '(not confirmed)'; all held -> confirmed (the allow case). R3: skb1 no longer runs under `--timeout 1`; only _build_throwaway gets a short timeout (wrapper build_on_its_floor), every pre-build git read keeps the helper's default deadline (observed builds=[479]), and the case asserts the basis says the BUILD timed out ('could not build the throwaway tree: the run timed out').
